Every time I come back, you welcome me with the biggest of hearts 💖 and the loudest of cheers 🎬🙌. Witnessing the movie with you on one of the biggest screens in the country was truly an amazing experience 🍿✨.

​Make sure you watch Im Game at a theater near you 🎟️

​Massive thanks to @voxcinemas, @citycentredeira, @hit967fm, and my brother @shamnadziyad and @wayfarermstarfilmsme for a wonderful event 🤝
